coverage: Exact fixed 100 recipients, existing and absent inventory rows, unrelated accounts and items preserved
Star-ledger or completion-receipt failure rolls back all 100 grants; clean retry pays once
Lost commit response and subsequent normal spending still replay the original receipt without another grant

concurrency.correction: Acquire existing inventory rows then wallets with FOR UPDATE NOWAIT; release the entire transaction immediately when a live game transaction already holds a required row.

release.reason: One-time authorized database grant through an isolated operations script. Only the grant script, fixed recipient list, scoped tests and verification record are committed.
